svg.title: MCX over IMS and 5G: three-column functional architecture
svg.desc: The left column is a UE containing MCX, IMS and 5G clients. The middle column is separate 5G NG-RAN access. The right column stacks MCX above IMS above 5G Core. It shows the MC service server to PCF N5 policy path and two location sources: UE LMC reports to MCX LMS, and LMS obtains operator location through NEF, GMLC, AMF and LMF.
svg.text: Three columns · 5G QoS and named reference points
Access control, policy, QoS flows and user-plane delivery
Application control, floor / transmission control and distribution
AF role on N5: MCPTT-5 · MCVideo-5 · MCData-5
UE clients ↔ IdMS / GMS / CMS / KMS / LMS
Server ↔ common services: CSC-3/5/9/15 · CMS ↔ user DB: CSC-13
IMS handles SIP. MCX common-service HTTP and media use 5G IP connectivity without traversing the SIP core.
GMLC/LMF positioning example; NEF may use AMF for cell-level location.
Direct policy path; no IMS SIP hop
Support: NRF discovery (Nnrf) · NEF exposure (N33 for LCS or indirect QoS) · SCP optional
5QI alone does not guarantee bit rate; admitted GBR flows provide GFBR.
